Detailed tutorials, from scratch, for **localdatasus**. You will learn how to download Brazilian health data by neighborhood, make maps and understand where the numbers come from.

You don't need much programming experience: every step has ready-to-copy code.

::: {.callout-note}
## A note on language
The package, like its Brazilian data sources, uses Portuguese names: `obitos` = deaths, `nascimentos` = births, `agravos` = notifiable diseases, `internacoes` = hospitalizations, `bairro` = neighborhood, `anos` = years, `por` = "by" (breakdown). These tutorials translate everything along the way.
:::
